method: Renders r_w9 (commit 250f186) compared with r_w8, omaat_f5, f11, f32, f57, f58, f60 and the official f_17313 / f_17314. Colours are PIL box means, compared as luminance ratios within one image. Sizes are scaled from the 0.952 x 0.535 m screen glass. Code: src/09d_suite.js (337 lines). Crops: scratchpad/qa9a/.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8a MED: keypad and handset lay almost flat (-12 deg) on a slab module
calibration.status: fixed, but overshot. Lines 166-169 and 184 build a 35 deg wedge with the keypad and handset on its seat-facing slope, which matches the omaat_f57 orientation. The wedge is now too tall and boxy (see the new issue): it rises 0.145 m above the trough at the window edge, has hard triangular end faces and reads as a lectern in s4 and q04.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8a MED / w8b MED: the bed creases read as rods and the fold band as a whiter board
calibration.status: partly fixed. The crease rods are gone. The band (line 289) is now a soft loft in the duvet colour, but it still reads as a separate raised slab lying across the bed in q04, s5 and v2: band L239 vs duvet L224 in q04, with rounded, square-ended edges. Real beds have no such band: f57 shows a diagonal turned-down corner and f58 a rumpled sheet.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8a MED: the centre pier and mirror were narrow, with a tall window-type pill
calibration.status: mostly fixed. Line 105 gives the centre suite a 0.17 x 0.32 mirror, and in the q02 crop it reads as a broad mirror with the lamp at its outer top corner, close to f32 / f5. Remaining: it sits about 0.10 m lower than real and its corners are too round (low issue). The 74 deg pier is accepted.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8a LOW: the window mirror was too narrow (0.103)
calibration.status: fixed. pAng is 68 deg (line 96) and mW is 0.13 (line 105). The q03 crop shows a 0.13 x 0.44 mirror. It is now a full stadium, though (see issues).

calibration.earlier_issue: w8a LOW / w8b LOW: the fluted field was too light
calibration.status: fixed. v1 cap/field is 189/91 = 2.08 (f60 2.28; w8 1.71). Field #605b4c vs f60 #4a4937 is the right olive-grey family, slightly warmer. Field/flank is 2.33 vs 1.67 real, which is acceptable.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8a LOW / w8b LOW: dashed seam on the centre fin's aft edge
calibration.status: fixed. Lines 90-91 use square gBox strips 0.028 wide across the centre plane. The q02 fin crop (qa9a/q02_fin.png) shows a continuous taupe edge with no dashes.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8a LOW: the handset screen was sky-blue
calibration.status: fixed in the cabin. In q04 it is #3145bb (L77), close to the real deep blue (omaat_f57 #484263, L72). In studio s4 it washes to #9b9db3, which is studio light.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8a LOW: the caps were neutral cream, not warm olive-khaki
calibration.status: not fixed. fCap is '#8e897d' (line 22, R-B +17). q02 cap #b4b1a9 (R-B +11), v1 #c2bdb0, vs f60 #aba685 (+38) and f57 #88866f (+25). The official f_17313 is cooler (#86828d), so a mid hue is still wanted.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8a LOW: the far LOD had no window wing or pier wood
calibration.status: not fixed. In v5 the far unit's screen still sits on a plain taupe wall (lines 318-337).

calibration.earlier_issue: w8b MED: the body/cap two-tone was too weak
calibration.status: partly fixed. fShell is now #57524d (line 22): q02 exterior shell/cap is 102/178 = 0.57 and s3 125/167 = 0.75 (was 0.92), close to real (0.49-0.52). But fConsole (09_seats.js line 116, #7a736c, suite-only) still renders the niche, jambs, header, console fascia and raised module at about 0.85-0.95x the cap: q04 module/cap 164/173 = 0.95 vs f57 module/cap 89/133 = 0.67.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8b LOW: the vanity mirror had square corners
calibration.status: fixed / overshot. Lines 107-108 extrude rrectPts with r = min(0.065, mW/2 - 0.002). The window mirror (mW 0.13) becomes a full stadium (q03 crop), but omaat_f11 shows a rounded rectangle with r about 0.025-0.03 and nearly straight ends.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8b LOW: residual moire on the fluted leaves
calibration.status: not fixed. The s1 forward leaf (qa9a/s1leaf_s4mod.png) still shows a dotted crosshatch at grazing angle. In the cabin views at 930 px it is only mild.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8b LOW: the niche header was thin and the back's top corners square
calibration.status: not fixed. Line 268 is still a 0.09 header with r 0.035 fillets (line 270). f57 shows a header about 0.12-0.13 thick with r about 0.06-0.08 inner corners.

calibration.earlier_issue: w8a / w8b out of scope: horizontal tweed too light, large navy 1A plaque, hard sun patches
calibration.status: not fixed (other owners). q03 ottoman/table is 121/87 = 1.39 and s2 177/123 = 1.44, vs omaat_f11 1.0 and f_17313 0.85. The q04 1A plaque is still a large navy tile (f58 2K plaque is small and dark grey). The q04 sun patches are hard-edged.

details.detail: Aisle face, doors open and closed: fluted leaves, frames, pulls, LEDs, flanks
Window screen wall: rounded wing and rim, 43-in screen, cap
Centre pair: board, fin edge, 2D pier and mirror, lowered and raised divider
Console: fascia, tray, raised module, keypad, handset
Seat: back, flap, seams, niche header, lamps, pillow, armrest
Bed: pad, duvet, band, belt, pillows
Colour and materials: olive leaves, body/cap two-tone, wood, tweed

issues.issue: The new console module is a tall, hard-edged lectern. It rises 0.145 m above the trough at the window edge, with flat triangular end faces and sharp ridges. The real module is a low, sculpted step about 0.06-0.08 m high, with rounded transitions into the fascia; the handset sits in its own raised oval pod and the keypad sits forward on the lower slope.
issues.evidence: Code: line 166, ka 35 deg, xs0 = xo + 0.045, xs1 = xo + 0.19, y1 0.685, so y0 = 0.685 + 0.145 x tan35 = 0.787 (+0.012 lip) above a 0.655 trough. s4 crop (qa9a/s1leaf_s4mod.png): a grey desk lectern with vertical triangular ends. In q04 it reads as a box standing on the console. omaat_f57 crop (qa9a/f57_console.png) and f58: the keypad and handset faces barely clear the trough lip, the ends blend in, and the handset pod is a separate rounded rise.
issues.fix: Line 166: ka 35 -> 22*DEG and y1 0.685 -> 0.675, so y0 is about 0.734 and the window-side rise is about 0.08 including the lip. Line 167: add a 0.03 chamfer to each end by extruding the profile twice, 0.46 long for the full section plus 0.03-long end pieces scaled 0.7 in y, or cap the ends with gRBox(shelfW, y0 - 0.655, 0.04, 0.02, 2) so the end faces are rounded rather than triangular. Line 185: make the handset dock a rounded pod gRBox(0.10, 0.03, 0.23, 0.015, 3), not 0.008 r.

issues.issue: The bed fold band still reads as a separate raised slab lying across the duvet, lighter than the duvet and with square ends. The duvet and pad are the same white, so the duvet itself has no visible outline except this band. Neither real reference has a band: f57 shows a diagonal turned-down corner at the aisle-head side, and f58 shows a rumpled sheet whose edges shade grey.
issues.evidence: q04 crop (qa9a/q04_bed.png): band L239 vs duvet L224, standing about 0.07 above the surface with a rounded rim, like a bolster. s5 and v2 show the same slab at the head end of the duvet. omaat_f57: the duvet top edge turns down diagonally from the aisle side, the fold is the same white with soft grey shading, and the duvet (L220) is slightly darker than the pad (L199 is the warm-lit pad).
issues.fix: Line 289: delete the 0.20 band loft. In its place add the turned-down corner as a thin triangle in duv at the aisle-head corner: B.add(gExtrude([[0,0],[0.42,0],[0,0.34]], 0.012), M4.trs(xe - 0.02, 0.57, dz0 + 0.01, Math.PI, -Math.PI/2), duv), set so the triangle lies flat on the duvet top. Line 285: give duv c '#d2cec6' (about 0.94x the pad #f0efea in luminance) so the duvet edge reads against the pad, as in f57 / f58.

issues.issue: The body two-tone is fixed for the shells but not for fConsole. The niche jambs and header, console fascia, raised module and armrest-area taupe still render at 0.85-0.95x the cap. Real is 0.6-0.67x, so the seat area still reads as one light grey mass under the caps.
issues.evidence: Code: fConsole #7a736c (09_seats.js line 116, used only by 09d_suite.js) has luminance about 116 vs fCap #8e897d about 136 (0.85). q04 module/cap is 164/173 = 0.95. Real: omaat_f57 module/cap 89/133 = 0.67 and header/cap 81/133 = 0.61. f_17313 shell/cap is 81/133 = 0.61.
issues.fix: Line 22: add fConsole: { c: '#615a54', r: 0.45, l: LAYER.plastic } to the suite's Object.assign, which keeps the edit inside 09d_suite.js. Then re-measure q04 module/cap, aiming for about 0.65-0.7. The keypad (line 171 #4a4642) then sits about 0.8x the module, close to f57's 0.93.

issues.issue: The window mirror is now a full stadium (semicircular ends). The real window mirror in omaat_f11 is a rounded rectangle with near-straight ends and corner radius about 0.025-0.03, in a light frame. The centre mirror's corners are also too round (r 0.065 on 0.17).
issues.evidence: q03 crop (qa9a/q03_pier.png): a pill with fully round ends. omaat_f11 crop (qa9a/f11_pier.png): a squarish rounded rectangle. omaat_f32 2D: a rounded rectangle, r about 0.03.
issues.fix: Line 107: corner radius Math.min(0.03, mW/2 - 0.002). Line 108: Math.min(0.022, mW/2 - 0.011).

issues.issue: The centre (2D/2G) mirror sits about 0.10 m too low. In the photos its top is at about the screen top, beside the lamp. In the render it starts about 0.15 below the screen top.
issues.evidence: omaat_f32: the 2D mirror spans about 10-78 % of the screen height from the top. omaat_f5: the mirror top is about level with the screen top. q02 crop (qa9a/q02_pier.png): the mirror spans about 28-77 %. Code line 105: mY = scy - 0.05, mH 0.32.
issues.fix: Line 105: for the centre suite use mW = Math.min(0.14, pw - 0.09), mH = 0.36, mY = scy + 0.03, so the top is at 1.175, beside the lamp at pt(pw - 0.042, H - 0.09) (line 109). With pw 0.236 the mirror spans x 0.015-0.155 and the lamp ring starts at 0.157, so they stay clear.

issues.issue: The caps are still neutral cream-grey, not the olive-khaki of the in-flight photos.
issues.evidence: q02 cap #b4b1a9 (R-B +11), v1 #c2bdb0 vs omaat_f60 #aba685 (R-B +38), f57 #88866f (+25). The official f_17313 is cooler (#86828d), so aim between them.

issues.issue: The niche header is still thin with small inner fillets (raised by rater B in w8 and not addressed).
issues.evidence: s4: the 0.09 header has r 0.035 fillets. omaat_f57: the header is about 0.12-0.13 with r about 0.06-0.08 inner corners, and the lamps sit on its face.
issues.fix: Line 268: header 0.12 (centre H - 0.06); line 270: fr 0.06 and fp from H - 0.12. To keep clearance, lower the back top: line 302 SEC 0.70 / 0.725 -> 0.67 / 0.695 and line 305 flap y 0.727 -> 0.697, so the back top is about 1.11, under the 1.12 header.

issues.issue: Moire persists on the fluted leaves at grazing angles in studio.
issues.evidence: s1 forward leaf (qa9a/s1leaf_s4mod.png, left): a dotted crosshatch. It is mild in the cabin views.
issues.fix: Line 19: fFluteGap '#3b3a33' -> '#413f37' (groove/slat about 0.88) and drop l: LAYER.plastic from fFlute so the layer texture does not beat against the 0.026 pitch.

issues.issue: The far LOD still lacks the window wing and pier wood, so dark verticals pop in at the LOD switch.
issues.evidence: v5: the far unit's screen sits on plain taupe.
issues.fix: After line 335: for !c add B.add(gBox(0.10, H - 0.68, 0.03), M4.trs(-hx + 0.08, 0.68 + (H - 0.68) / 2, -L + 0.135), SEATMAT.fWood), and for both a pier box gBox(0.22, H - 0.645, 0.03) in fWood at x scx + 0.56, rotated -(c ? 74 : 68) deg.

issues.issue: Out of scope, noted only: the horizontal tweed (ottoman, cushion) reads too light under cabin and studio light; the 1A plaque is a large navy tile; the sun patches on the bed are hard-edged; studio light washes the handset screen.
issues.evidence: q03 ottoman/table 1.39 and s2 1.44 vs omaat_f11 1.0 and f_17313 0.85; the base colour fFabric #6c655d is close to f_17313 #676166, so this is top fill. q04 plaque vs f58 small grey 2K plaque.
issues.fix: Lighting owner (12_scene.js / 04_shaders.js): less top fill on horizontal fabric. Seats owner (09_seats.js): plaque about 0.05 x 0.025, dark grey.

questions: Bed default: should the made bed show the diagonal turned-down corner of omaat_f57 or the plain rumpled sheet of f58? Either way the cross band should go.

Body hue: the in-flight photos show a warm brown-taupe niche (#524132), but the official f_17313 is cool (#534f52). The value ratio (about 0.6-0.67x the cap) is agreed in both. Which hue should the fConsole override follow?
